invariants: all limits are nonnegative; expectedColumns is nonnegative and does not exceed maxFieldsPerRecord
Either is a reader policy and is rejected by writer construction; CRLF and LF are explicit output policies
each successful call emits one complete record including its final line ending
zero fields is InvalidRecord; one empty field is quoted and remains a real record
empty fields and fields containing comma, quote, CR or LF are quoted; quote bytes are doubled
UTF-8 bytes, spaces and BOM bytes are preserved; ASCII controls except CR and LF are rejected
maxFieldBytes counts decoded UTF-8 while maxOutputBytes counts cumulative encoded bytes including quoting, commas and line endings
every size addition is checked against the remaining output budget before arithmetic can overflow
record and field limits and exact positive expectedColumns are checked before writes
every failure leaves the entire output, length, capacity, bytesWritten and recordsWritten unchanged
OutputTooSmall reports the exact required complete-record byte count and permits retry
error offset is the cumulative committed byte count; requiredBytes is zero except for OutputTooSmall
success changes only the encoded output prefix; length, capacity and tail are unchanged
writer state and budget identity are private; the library allocates no storage and has no implicit I/O or async effect
acceptance: The focused gate requires native exact output, independent encoding and parser roundtrip, zero-allocation LLVM audit, ownership/privacy negatives before LLVM, and verified actual/golden byte equality. Required selfhost/target closure remains separate. This is a defined UTF-8 profile, not an unqualified RFC conformance claim.
